title: Evidence Record
description: A single piece of evidence extracted from an academic paper. Every claim in the literature review should be traceable to one or more evidence records.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence record.

paper_id.description: Internal ID of the source paper (matches source.schema.json id field).

statement.description: A clear, complete statement of the evidence in the researcher's words. Must not be a fabricated paraphrase — base on abstract or full text only.

supporting_text.description: A direct, bounded quotation from the source. Must be exact. Null if no direct quote is used.

page_number.description: Page number of the supporting text. Only populate when extracted from full text — never fabricate.

section.description: Section of the paper where this evidence appears (e.g., 'Abstract', 'Methods', 'Results', 'Discussion').

confidence_score.description: Confidence in the accuracy of this extraction (0.0–1.0). Lower values indicate uncertain or fallback extractions.

verified.description: Whether a human reviewer has verified this evidence record.

verification_notes.description: Human reviewer notes on accuracy or corrections needed.
